scoring_justification: Cannot recompute exact paper values without re-running the self-consistent solver; we verify structural properties (monotonic decrease, allowable ranges) and cross-artifact consistency.

hidden_assets.purpose: No separate numeric gold file; all required structural bounds and consistency rules are defined directly in the scorer code.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from the paper's expected qualitative behavior (magnetization decrease, Zener fraction collapse) and the model's physical ranges.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Ranges and structural rules chosen to accept any correct implementation of the model while excluding degenerate submissions.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are structural checks, not fabricated target numbers; they reflect the known physics of the model.

outputs.description: Normalized magnetization M/M0 vs temperature for each doping level.
Critical temperature Tc vs doping x.
Zener phase fraction p_f vs temperature at x=0.3.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the agent's reported magnetization curves, Tc values, and Zener fraction to paper-reported reference values with appropriate tolerances. The magnetization curve step is load-bearing; it requires genuine execution of the self-consistent solver.

steps.description: Magnetization curves: columns correct, M in [0,1], monotonic decrease with T for each doping level, and sufficient variation.
Phase diagram: columns correct, Tc within [0.005,0.1] eV/k_B, non-degenerate values (std > 0.001 eV/k_B).
Zener fraction: columns correct, p_f in [0,1], monotonic decrease, low-T p_f ≥ 0.4, high-T p_f ≤ 0.2, and drop ≥ 0.3.
Cross-check: Tc extracted from magnetization steepest descent matches phase diagram Tc within 0.01 eV/k_B.
